`final class GlCapabilities`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.base.opengl.capability` · **Module:** `base-opengl` · **Source:** [GlCapabilities.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/base/opengl/src/main/java/dev/joid/base/opengl/capability/GlCapabilities.java)<br/>
**Backends:** <span class="joid-badge">LWJGL 2</span> <span class="joid-badge">LWJGL 3</span>

What the current OpenGL context offers, read once when the render bridge is created: versions, profile, extensions and limits.

## Description

[`GlRenderBridge`](/reference/base-opengl/glrenderbridge/) picks one path per feature from it: GLSL dialect, framebuffer family, vertex arrays, mipmap builder.

## Learn more

- [Capabilities and paths](/build/base-modules/opengl/#capabilities-and-paths)

## Creation details

<a id="GlCapabilities-factory-read"></a>

### read

`GlCapabilities read(IGlBinding binding)` <span class="joid-qualifier">factory</span>

**Throws:**

- `IllegalStateException`: No OpenGL context is current: create the context of JOID and make it current before registering the backend

Reads the capabilities of the current context.
Throws an `IllegalStateException` when no OpenGL context is current on the calling thread.

<a id="GlCapabilities-method-require"></a>

### require

`this require()` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>

**Throws:**

- `IllegalStateException`: JOID needs OpenGL 2.1 with GLSL 1.20, this context offers …: update the graphics driver or create a newer OpenGL context
- `IllegalStateException`: JOID needs framebuffer objects (OpenGL 3.0, GL_ARB_framebuffer_object or GL_EXT_framebuffer_object), this context offers …: update the graphics driver or create a newer OpenGL context

Returns the capabilities when JOID can draw with them.
Throws an `IllegalStateException` that names the context below OpenGL 2.1 with GLSL 1.20, or without any framebuffer object.
